snippet.title: Idle Monkey Theorem - Official Trailer | Can Monkeys REALLY Write Shakespeare? 🐒⌨️
snippet.description:
🍌 Wishlist NOW on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4298380

🐒 PROVE THE THEOREM! Have you heard of the "Infinite Monkey Theorem"?

Can monkeys actually write Shakespeare? Find out in Idle Monkey Theorem!

🎮 KEY FEATURES:
- Build your army of up to 28 adorable typing monkeys
- Watch them randomly generate words on their tiny typewriters
- Match words to recreate Shakespeare's complete works
- Harvest Inspiration Points to buy upgrades and grow your team
- Smart pity system ensures you're never stuck for too long

📜 From sonnets to plays, your monkeys will type it all—one random word at a time!

🔥 6 unique upgrade paths | 10-node skill tree | Offline progress
💾 Steam Cloud Save support

#IdleGame #Clicker #IncrementalGame #IndieGame #Shakespeare #Gaming
